record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add a residual feed-forward block after each GRU output: h'=h+W2(GELU(W1(h))), with intermediate width 256 and W2 initialized to zero. Apply it identically in training and inference. This preserves the initial recurrent representation while allowing nonlinear refinement for item compatibility. Keep embeddings, history selection, final-real-position readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Update the predictor writer to load the added parameters; retain one model per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Add a jointly trained 256-unit residual GELU block after each GRU output across all four datasets. Zero initialization of the output projection preserves the initial recurrent representation. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, so it constructs and loads the same added parameters. Preserve embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer.
